capabilities: Set any vault image as a file or folder icon
Show image icons in tab headers
Store note icons in a frontmatter property
Replace callout and admonition icons with images
Remove icons via context menu or command
extras: Makes no network requests; note icons are a normal frontmatter property (default image-icon) while other items are stored in the plugin's data.json; icons follow renames and moves and are cleaned up on delete.
problem: Obsidian icon options are limited to icon packs and emoji, so you cannot use your own pictures as icons for files, folders or callouts.

relations.evidence: Works alongside Iconize: when a file or folder has an image icon, the Iconize icon is hidden

summary: Plugin that uses any vault image as the icon for files, folders, callouts and tab headers.
